note: This file is a configuration-only module with no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It defines default runtime settings for MMPretrain training pipelines as a collection of variable assignments.
summary: default_runtime.py provides default configuration values for MMPretrain training runs including: default_scope (registry scope), default_hooks (timer, logger, param_scheduler, checkpoint, sampler_seed, visualization), env_cfg (cudnn_benchmark, multiprocessing, distributed backend), vis_backends (LocalVisBackend, TensorboardVisBackend), visualizer (UniversalVisualizer), log_level, load_from, resume, and randomness settings.
variables: default_scope - set to 'mmpretrain' to use MMPretrain registries
default_hooks - dict of training hooks: IterTimerHook, LoggerHook, ParamSchedulerHook, CheckpointHook, DistSamplerSeedHook, VisualizationHook
env_cfg - environment config: cudnn_benchmark, mp_cfg (fork start method), dist_cfg (nccl backend)
vis_backends - list of visualization backends: LocalVisBackend, TensorboardVisBackend
load_from - path to checkpoint to load from (default None)
resume - whether to resume training (default False)
randomness - random seed and deterministic settings (default seed=None, deterministic=False)
use_cases: Use as a base config file in MMPretrain training pipelines by referencing it in config inheritance
Override default_hooks to customize training hooks like checkpoint frequency or logger interval
Modify env_cfg to change distributed training backend or multiprocessing settings
Enable visualization by setting VisualizationHook enable=True and adding WandbVisBackend
Set load_from and resume=True to continue training from a saved checkpoint
